description: Find upcoming events — concerts, gigs, meetups, conferences, festivals — from the events product, soonest first, with structured date/venue fields; filter by kind, genre, topic, and date range. Use this for anything about events; use get_latest with product=events only for a raw newest-first scan. Read-only: returns public event data and needs no API key. Filter by city yourself using `event.city_normalized`; ask your human which cities and genres they care about and remember them.

from.description: Optional ISO date or datetime; only events starting on or after this.

genres.description: Optional genre tags for music/festival events.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

to.description: Optional ISO date or datetime; only events starting on or before this.

topics.description: Optional free-form topic tags for meetups/conferences.

name: find_events

event.description: Structured event fields (starts_at, venue, city, city_normalized, country, artists, organizer, ...).

summary.description: Short summary, or null when the item has not been enriched yet.

title: Find Events
